description: Use this when an owner says a gym Phorme already lists is theirs and nobody runs it on Phorme yet, for example "that gym is mine". Confirm the place with the owner first, and set confirmation to true only after they said yes. It never hands the place over by itself: Phorme sends a six digit code to the email or phone the place has on file, not to the person asking. Whoever reads that inbox or phone gives them the code, and entering it makes them the owner. A place with neither on file waits for Phorme's team. It takes no payment. It needs a connected Phorme account.

confirmation.description: Set to true only after the owner said yes to claiming this place.

place_id.description: The place_id of the listed place, from find_gym_class.

via.description: Where the code goes, when the place has both on file. Default email.

name: claim_place

claim.description: claim_id, place_id, place_name, status (code_sent or review), channel, sent_to (masked), expires_at.

title: Claim a place nobody runs
